test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct option that indicates the arrangement of the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Finger

2. Elbow

3. Wrist

4. Nail

5. Palm
solution:
The correct arrangement considering the representation of the the structure of the human arm and hand. would be:

4. Nail (Hard covering at the tip of the finger)

1. Finger (Digits at the end of the hand)

5. Palm (Central part of the hand)

3. Wrist (Joint connecting the hand to the forearm)

2. Elbow (Joint connecting the forearm to the upper arm)

Hence, "**4, 1, 5, 3, 2**" is the correct answer.
